title: The unknown-reads contract lint runs on Linux only
why: Retrospective CI audit 15:53 CST Nov 12: lint/check_unknown_reads_contract.py runs on Linux, macOS and Windows (checks.yml:551, :1183, :1896), against decision test-strategy-reset line 20 ("pure lints run on ubuntu only"). Lane question 03:23 CST Nov 14 (lane of #3005, head 06ccf55df, sent direct; unchecked by triage): the coordinator's 03:20 note said this step cuts macOS work; #3005 removes only the Windows run of the unknown-reads lint, and the macOS run (checks-macos, checks.yml l.1344 on main 4db2a9cf3) stays for step ci-mac-once-per-batch. This step's own text says the same. Answer by triage: keep #3005 Windows-only (the lane's own option a, no widening, no departure from main), so no owner question. The lane waits on runner 10 for the lane lint. Correction 03:24 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:24): my 03:25 answer "(a) Windows-only" is overruled by the coordinator, an undoable pick of its own; it says its own 03:21 message (the PR "cuts one macOS step") was said without reading the diff, and its first correction swung back without reading it either. The lane reads the head: both runs dropped. Sighting 03:28 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:27, from the #3005 lane's read of the file; unchecked by triage): `.github/scripts/ci-scope.sh` line 44 still maps edits to lint/check_unknown_reads_contract.py to the Windows, macOS and guard job flags, so after #3005 an edit to that file starts jobs that no longer run it. Triage pick: the cause is the #3005 change, so the home is step unknown-reads-lint-linux-only (its lane drops the mapping from ci-scope.sh in the same PR, or says why not, and a test proves an edit to that file sets no Windows or macOS flag); step macos-jobs-gated-by-scope reads the same file and takes the corrected flags. No new step. Update 03:29 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:28): the lane keeps the ci-scope.sh line 44 mapping out of #3005 (it fails safe: extra jobs only; a head move costs another round and lane lint); the follow-up is its own step scope-drops-dead-lint-mapping, replacing the sighting filed here a few minutes earlier. OWNER QUESTION 05:24 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 05:24; the coordinator read the record comment 6876422660 by REST; the rest is the lane's report, unchecked by triage): #3005 head 013e6d573d61 (ls-remote 05:13). The record shows round 1 sonnet FAIL, round 2 sonnet PASS; round 1's real reviewer was haiku (a fresh haiku reviewer re-read the diff: FAIL on one flag, checks 1 and 2 PASS). The tool refuses a second record at this head ("a new branch with a new PR is the only way out"). The lane wrote test and change itself (rule G12), no test-author, though the grant said a test-author writes the done check's cases (source of that grant not found by triage); the red run on main 06ccf55df is the lane's own. Posted as owner item 832: (a) merge as it is, (b) a fresh test-author and a round 3 on a new head, (c) a new branch and PR with a test-author and a clean record; the coordinator recommends c; no star. #3005 is held out of runner 10's order meanwhile.
note: Drop both the Windows run and the macOS run of the lint, so it runs on Linux only (coordinator pick 03:24 CST Nov 14, overruling triage's earlier Windows-only answer; the macOS drop is also listed in ci-mac-once-per-batch, whose lane is archived, so no clash). Lane head 013e6d573 does both, with a new test red on 06ccf55df and green on the head (the lane's read, unchecked by triage). Express under R55 (CI fixes).
